CopperCanyon_Text_Npc1.en: RHYHORN charged me. I ran very\nfast.
CopperCanyon_Text_Npc1.fr: RHINOCORNE m'a chargé. J'ai couru\ntrès vite.

CopperCanyon_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

CopperCanyon_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
CopperCanyon_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
